session_summary: Triaged 3 open PRs. Detected duplicate reflection-processing in #33/#34 by file-list + diff comparison — both touched the exact same 9 files including the same 3 reflection JSONs and the same regions of src/templates.js. Picked #33 (broader guidance) and closed #34 with a clear comment so the human record stays intact. Then rebased PR #35 onto post-#33 main. Conflict resolution rules kept main's #33 template additions AND our v3.10.0 changes — never downgraded version, never unprocessed reflections. Force-with-lease push, then merged. Final main: 90767e9.
overall_notes: PR-sweep workflow: gh pr list --json → diff overlap analysis → merge order plan → execute. Did not need micro-agent for the merge itself (gh CLI is the right level). Only the conflict resolution required a sub-agent.
